source: Written for VPM to the upstream package's API and behavior. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: Written for VPM: each serializeStyles call keeps its state (registered styles, props, collected keyframes) in its own object instead of module variables saved and restored around nested calls.

Units are decided with the camelCase form of a key, so unitless properties written in kebab-case ('font-weight': 600, 'line-height': 1.5) no longer get px; the original added px in production and only warned in development.
An array of values starting with a number is a fallback list (width: [100, '50%'] is width:100px;width:50%;), not a selector block (width{100;50%;}).
Custom properties are keys starting with --; the original took any key whose second character is - (so z-index escaped the kebab-case warning).
On vemotion-hash, vemotion-unitless and vemotion-memoize, so non-ASCII styles get distinct class names and gridArea and lineClamp take no px.
csstype, used only by the declarations, is a peer dependency.
ES module with bundled declarations; the #is-development condition chooses development or production behavior.

verification.upstreamSuite: Emotion's 293 tests (hash, weak-memoize, sheet, cache, react, styled) pass with this package in place of the original, in development and production builds.
verification.differential: compare-serialize.cjs: 20,000 generated style arguments give the same name, styles, keyframes, messages and errors as @emotion/serialize 1.3.3 in development and production, on Node and Bun.
verification.declarations: types.cjs compiles an application against the declarations with DOM types under the configured TypeScript 7 compiler.
